screen.title: Undo Send: 30 seconds
screen.body:
1. Gmail on a computer: gear > See all settings
2. General > Undo Send > 30 seconds
3. Scroll down > Save Changes
4. Outlook web: Settings > Mail > Compose and reply > Undo send

Comment UNDO for the steps

beats.say: Done! I also replied all that you turned it on!
